name: River's Reflection

source.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

text: Existing between life and death can offer insights when it comes to channeling the energies of life and death. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell with the vitality or void traits, that spell's effects on living and undead targets are reversed. All void damage becomes vitality damage and vice versa. Any ability to heal living creatures or undead creatures is similarly swapped.
